slice: KeyIndex per-slot probe hashes and matched-entry reuse (packages/foundation/src/collections/key-index.ts)
rootCause: Images with managed surfaces (Test262, in-image JIT) store every TS list as the AVL SparseList (lowerReferenceLists declines: stableRecordLayouts rejects JIT host calls). KeyIndex kept hashes only on entries, so each occupied-slot probe read the entries list (an O(log n) tree walk) and get/set/delete read it again after a hit. Symbolized samples on main: New_Tai_Lue readList 27.7% exclusive (66% of it from key-index position), decodeURI readList 12% + position 9%, 24-eval preparation readList 32.6% (~45% of it from position).
change: Uint32Array of per-slot stored hashes filters probes before any entries read; position records the matched entry for its caller. Semantics unchanged (red-first not applicable to a representation-only change; characterization tests added: probe filtering compares only equal-hash keys, tombstone reuse, re-entrant pure equality).

nativeBenchmark.method: Same 6-case native Script fixture (Test262 harness + test source inlined; tools/native-script-fixture.ts, TINT_BUILD_ONLY, TINT_DEBUG_SYMBOLS) built from base and candidate snapshots; alternating order per round, LLDB-contained (stop-at-entry asserted, exit 42), user CPU of the LLDB tree via /usr/bin/time -p; 2 rounds.

extraObservation: Single runs of a 24-direct-eval fixture (eval preparation in the image): 44.22 -> 38.53 CPU-s (base vs candidate), exit 42; not a matched benchmark.
